lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance, roughly circular spots are arranged in a grid-like formation posterior to the gill slits. The spots are organized into vertical columns of 3 to 5 units each, with the highest intensity centroids located in the mid-lateral region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the columns of high-luminance blobs, forming a repetitive vertical-horizontal grid pattern across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct longitudinal ridges are visible on the dorsal-lateral surface, characterized by a sharp vertical intensity gradient with high-luminance superior edges and shadowed inferior edges running parallel to the body axis.

other_distinctive_markers: Five prominent vertical gill slits are clearly visible on the lateral surface, characterized by high-contrast dark apertures between skin folds.
